stepExplanation: Impulse = Change in momentum = m(v_f - v_i) = 0.15 kg x (20 - 0) m/s = 3 kg.m/s (or 3 N.s)
stepBody: Calculate the impulse delivered to the ball. Use the impulse-momentum theorem: Impulse = Change in momentum = $$m \Delta v$$. The ball starts from rest ($$v_i = 0$$). Give your answer in kg.m/s or N.s.
